Name: SinZational Shared Spaces
Author: SinZ163
Description:
This mod removes the mandatory link between cabins and the creation of farmhands.

When someone joins a multiplayer save where the host has this mod, there will always be an available spot to create a new farmhand, and when they spawn into their "cabin", they will land outside the main farmhouse.

Next to the farmhouse door is an elevator panel of sorts, that lets you pick which interior you want to go to, using the name of the farmer that owns that interior.
The farmhouse door takes you to the most recently selected interior, or the one you spawned in if you haven't specified.

This mod also makes it so anyone can use the farmhouse mailbox, as farmhands wont have a cabin anymore to have their own mailbox.
Everyone sees their own mail, just like the island farmhouse mailbox.

Recommended mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1929]StardewLocations[/url] as it will say which interior you are entering.

[b]
WARNING:[/b]
The save will not be playable if this mod is removed while cabin interiors exist that were created by this mod, I'm hoping to address this in future updates.
[b]
Upcoming changes:[/b]
Allow migrating cabin interiors from existing placed Cabins to the Primary Farmhouse (to use this mod for an existing save)
Allow migrating cabin interiors from the primary farmhouse back to a placed cabin (So this mod can be safely uninstalled)

Source code: https://github.com/SinZ163/StardewMods
